about_short_description.short_description: Indexical is a platform that uses a sequence of performances, workshops to introduce the public to radical and unorthodox artistic work.

product.name: Performance Series
product.description: A series of live performances showcasing experimental and radical artistic works, primarily in music and time-based visual or performing arts.

product.name: Workshops
product.description: Educational sessions designed to introduce participants to experimental artistic practices, including music and sound art techniques.

product.name: Exhibitions
product.description: Curated art exhibitions featuring installations and visual works that explore experimental and radical artistic themes.

product.name: Santa Cruz Synth Cooperative Events
product.description: Monthly meetups and open mic nights for electronic music practitioners to share performances, demonstrations, and discussions.

product.name: Podcast Series
product.description: A series of recorded interviews and conversations with experimental musicians and artists discussing their work and creative processes.
